Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses two main proteomics approaches: one based on FLAG-tag immunoprecipitation (AP-MS) and another based on FPLC co-elution followed by in-gel digestion. Both used DDA on an Orbitrap Lumos. While the paper discusses glycation (AGEs), the mass spectrometry described in the methods is used for protein-protein interaction identification (AP-MS), not for the enrichment of glycated peptides (which were detected via immunoblotting/slot blots).

organism: All searches were performed against UniProt Knowledgebase protein database with the selected taxonomy Mus musculus (mouse).

All peak lists were searched in parallel against the UniProtKB/Swiss-Prot protein databases Homo sapiens (20,316 sequences, released 2018_11) and Escherichia coli strain K12 (4418 sequences, released 2018_11)
cell_lines: HEK293 and COS7 cells were obtained from American Type Culture Collection

scope: GATD3A:FLAG was immunoprecipitated from Gatd3aFLAG/FLAG mouse heart mitochondria

Magnetic anti-FLAG epitope conjugated beads (Millipore Sigma, M8823) were washed with IP buffer containing detergent three times, and equal concentrations of protein were added to beads at 4 °C overnight.
This dataset consists of peptides identified following in-gel digestions of bands observed following FPLC purification of recombinant human GATD3A.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The input text describes two distinct MS experiments. One involves affinity purification (IP) of GATD3A from mouse heart mitochondria (PXD030977), and the other involves FPLC purification of recombinant human GATD3A expressed in E. coli (PXD030978). Both fall under the 'purified protein or complex' scope, specifically affinity-purified.
